buffer_name.description: Buffer solution used for the loading isotherm experiment.

salt_name.description: Name/identity of the salt used in the experiment.

process_run_id.description: Identifier of the automated process run (as defined in the control software).

pump_speed.description: Pump speed used during loading / equilibration (units as configured on instrument).

replicates.description: Number of technical replicates per condition (per ligand/salt combination).

resin_mass_mg.description: Mass of resin used in each well.

ligand_name.description: Name/identity of the ligand whose loading is measured.

total_volume_uL.description: Total liquid volume used per well for the binding experiment.

venting_time_s.description: Venting time during liquid handling steps.

pump_duration_s.description: Pump operation duration per cycle or step.

incubation_time_min.description: Incubation time for the loading isotherm.

salt_concentrations.description: List of salt concentrations used in the experiment (parsed from a delimited field). Elements are numeric if all entries are numeric, otherwise strings.

equilibration_cycles.description: Number of equilibration cycles performed before measurement.

ligand_concentrations.description: List of ligand concentrations used in the experiment (parsed from a delimited field). Elements are numeric if all entries are numeric, otherwise strings.

incubation_temperature_c.description: Incubation temperature during the isotherm experiment.

measurement_wavelength_nm.description: Measurement wavelength of the plate reader.

calibration_curve_slope.description: Slope of the calibration curve used to convert absorbance to concentration.

salt_concentration_unit.description: Unit of the salt concentration values (e.g., mM).

salt_stock_concentration.description: Stock concentration of the salt solution (numeric part only).

ligand_concentration_unit.description: Unit of the ligand concentration values (e.g., µM, mM).

ligand_stock_concentration.description: Stock concentration of the ligand solution (numeric part only).

calibration_curve_intercept.description: Intercept of the calibration curve used to convert absorbance to concentration.

number_of_salt_concentrations.description: Number of distinct salt concentrations configured for the plate.

number_of_ligand_concentrations.description: Number of distinct ligand concentrations configured for the plate.

analysis_status.description: Status of the analysis as reported by the analysis script.

analysis_message.description: Human-readable message describing the analysis outcome or error.

timestamp.description: Timestamp when the commit script collected the analysis results (UTC).

summary.description: Key metrics from Langmuir fits across salt concentrations.

n_salt_conditions.description: Number of salt conditions for which Langmuir fits were performed (rows in fit parameter table).

q_max_values.description: List of fitted q_max values for each salt condition (if available).

K_values.description: List of fitted Langmuir binding constants K for each salt condition (if available).

r2_values.description: List of R^2 values describing fit quality for each salt condition (if available).

data_files.description: Output data file paths produced by the analysis script.

tecan_raw_excel.description: Path to the copied raw Tecan Excel file.

processed_well_data_csv.description: Path to CSV with per-well processed data.

aggregated_isotherm_csv.description: Path to CSV with aggregated isotherm data per ligand/salt condition.

langmuir_fit_parameters_csv.description: Path to CSV with Langmuir fit parameters per salt concentration.

analysis_results_json.description: Path to JSON file containing the full analysis_results dictionary from the analysis script.

plots.description: Plot file paths produced by the analysis script.

isotherms_png.description: Path to PNG plot of loading isotherms with Langmuir fits.

isotherms_pdf.description: Path to PDF plot of loading isotherms with Langmuir fits.

warnings.description: List of warning messages returned by the analysis script, if any.
